newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen shareholder says not selling stock.
newsitem.headline: Loewen shareholder says not selling stock.

text.p: Honorine Flanagan, a shareholder in the Loewen Group Inc, said Thursday she and her husband are not selling any of their shares in the funeral company despite Loewen's SEC filing to the contrary.

Loewen in a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission said the couple along with other shareholders would sell a total 1.2 million shares. The filing covered 148,630 common shares owned by the couple and 84,081 shares owned by Honorine Flanagan alone. "I don't know where this came from. This is the first I've heard of this. We are definitely not selling any stock. We'd be crazy to," she said.
A Loewen spokesman said the filings were made merely to update a previous filing to reflect a hostile takeover bid for the company by Service Corp International.
Loewen was obligated under a deal to buy the Flanagans' business to register their shares so they could be sold in the open market, he said.
